name: Big Brain Academy: Brain vs. Brain

achievements.name: Practice Round
achievements.detail: Finish a Practice session of any activity.

achievements.name: All Five
achievements.detail: Clear a Practice activity in Identify, Memorize, Analyze, Compute, and Visualize.

achievements.name: Whack Match
achievements.detail: Clear Whack Match, the Identify activity about striking the matching target.

achievements.name: Lobe Medal
achievements.detail: Earn a Lobe Medal from your score on a Practice activity.

achievements.name: Gold Medal
achievements.detail: Earn a Gold Lobe Medal on any Practice activity.

achievements.name: Platinum Medal
achievements.detail: Earn a Platinum Lobe Medal on a Practice activity.

achievements.name: Brain Test
achievements.detail: Finish Test mode and compare your results across the five categories.

achievements.name: Party Winner
achievements.detail: Take the highest score in a Party match.

achievements.name: Spin the Wheel
achievements.detail: Play a Party round whose activity is picked by spinning the wheel.

achievements.name: Ghost Clash
achievements.detail: Win a Ghost Clash against another player's saved record.

achievements.name: Super Practice
achievements.detail: Unlock Super Practice by earning a one-star Gold Lobe Medal on every activity.
